method: Computed with the existing pipeline/mars.py measure function, unchanged. MOLA source file supplied from the local NASA SHARE download; TES albedo, TES night thermal inertia and SWIM from data/raw. Elevation is a single DEM pixel; slope and roughness use the existing square pixel neighbourhood and latitude-adjusted x spacing; albedo is a single TES pixel. SWIM and TI use their existing neighbourhood rules. This extraction does not change the research pipeline method.
